name: ophtra
description: OPHTRA — premium corporate website and API for a modern ophthalmology centre.

scripts.dev: npm --prefix backend run dev & npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run seo:generate && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix backend run test
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
